steps.title: One stock's trend
steps.say: Here's Apple over the last month, smoothed with a 5-day average. It's {AAPL.dir_1m} about {AAPL.pct_1m} percent. The tap marks its highest point.
steps.alt: Apple trend line with a tap at its peak.

steps.title: What an ETF is
steps.say: An ETF is one share that holds many companies. VOO holds the 500 largest US companies, so you own a tiny slice of each.
steps.alt: A chord of tones, no drawing.

steps.title: Feel the difference
steps.say: First Apple on its own, then VOO on the same scale. The second line barely moves. That smoothing is diversification.
steps.alt: Apple as a solid line, then VOO as a dashed line on the same scale.

steps.title: Fees add up
steps.say: Two funds with the same returns but different yearly fees, over 30 years. The 1 percent fee leaves you about a quarter less than VOO's 0.03 percent.
steps.alt: Two growth curves, the low-fee one ending higher.

quiz.q: Which usually moves more in a day: one stock, or a broad ETF?
quiz.why: An ETF spreads your money across many companies.
